import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    m = next(it)
    c0 = next(it)
    d0 = next(it)

    # dp[d] = max tugriks using exactly d grams of dough
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)

    # Process stuffing types as bounded knapsack on dough with extra constraint on stuffing amount
    for _ in range(m):
        ai = next(it)
        bi = next(it)
        ci = next(it)
        di = next(it)

        max_cnt = ai // bi  # maximum buns of this stuffing type
        if max_cnt == 0:
            continue

        # For each possible dough capacity, try using k buns of this type
        # We iterate dough from high to low to avoid reuse within same item
        for dough in range(n, -1, -1):
            # Try k buns of this stuffing type
            k = 1
            while k <= max_cnt:
                need_dough = k * ci
                if dough >= need_dough:
                    val = dp[dough - need_dough] + k * di
                    if val > dp[dough]:
                        dp[dough] = val
                    k += 1
                else:
                    break

    # Now add buns without stuffing (unbounded knapsack on dough)
    for dough in range(c0, n + 1):
        val = dp[dough - c0] + d0
        if val > dp[dough]:
            dp[dough] = val

    print(max(dp))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().strip().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)      # total dough
    m = next(it)      # number of stuffing types
    c0 = next(it)     # dough per plain bun
    d0 = next(it)     # profit per plain bun

    # dp[d] = max profit using exactly d grams of dough
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)

    # process each stuffing type
    for _ in range(m):
        ai = next(it)  # available grams of stuffing i
        bi = next(it)  # grams of stuffing per bun i
        ci = next(it)  # dough per bun i
        di = next(it)  # profit per bun i

        max_buns = ai // bi  # limited by stuffing amount
        if max_buns == 0:
            continue

        # bounded knapsack on dough capacity n
        # decompose max_buns into powers of two
        k = 1
        while max_buns > 0:
            take = min(k, max_buns)
            max_buns -= take
            weight = ci * take  # dough used
            value = di * take   # profit gained
            # 0/1 knapsack update
            for dough in range(n, weight - 1, -1):
                if dp[dough - weight] + value > dp[dough]:
                    dp[dough] = dp[dough - weight] + value
            k <<= 1

    # after using stuffings optimally, fill remaining dough with plain buns
    ans = 0
    for dough_used in range(n + 1):
        remaining = n - dough_used
        plain_buns = remaining // c0
        total_profit = dp[dough_used] + plain_buns * d0
        if total_profit > ans:
            ans = total_profit

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    m = next(it)
    c0 = next(it)
    d0 = next(it)

    # dp[dough_used] = max profit using exactly dough_used grams
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)

    # First, consider buns without stuffing (unlimited)
    for dough in range(c0, n + 1):
        dp[dough] = max(dp[dough], dp[dough - c0] + d0)

    # Now process each stuffing type as a bounded item
    for _ in range(m):
        ai = next(it)
        bi = next(it)
        ci = next(it)
        di = next(it)

        max_buns = ai // bi  # maximum buns of this stuffing
        if max_buns == 0:
            continue

        # Bounded knapsack for this stuffing type on dough dimension
        # Use binary splitting to convert to multiple 0/1 items
        k = 1
        items = []
        remaining = max_buns
        while k <= remaining:
            items.append(k)
            remaining -= k
            k <<= 1
        if remaining > 0:
            items.append(remaining)

        for cnt in items:
            dough_need = cnt * ci
            profit_gain = cnt * di
            for dough in range(n, dough_need - 1, -1):
                if dp[dough - dough_need] + profit_gain > dp[dough]:
                    dp[dough] = dp[dough - dough_need] + profit_gain

    print(max(dp))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
